itemList.description: Pure water pumping machinery at KSRTC Depot Vijayanagar: Design, Supply, erection, electrification and commissioning of 3 no’s of 300 HP or suitable HP Centrifugal pumpsets (100% stand by) at Pumphouse (Discharge - 210 LPS, H-70 mtrs), suitable capacity motor, required double flanged pipes and specials,Valves,Control switchgear panels, digital soft starters, GI pipe, 11 KV XLPE Cable / UG cable, 400KVA or suitable KVA,11KV /433V Copper wound Distribution Transformer, Supply & erection of 11kV HT Metering cubicle & LBS ,Providing chainlink fencing and Erection of Transformer Sub-Station, fire fighting equipments, along with allied accessories at Pumphouse at KSRTC depot, Vijayanagar and any other works required for completion and commissioning of the works, as directed by the Engineer In charge as per specifications and system design criteria. (Shall be read in conjunction with Section 7 special specifications of all the item).
